chunks: They are on guidance from their Lord, and they are the ones who will prosper.

key_terms.أُولَٰئِكَ: Those (demonstrative pronoun referring to the believers)

ai.seo_question: Who are the people that will truly prosper according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt, who are viewed as the ultimate embodiment of divine guidance (Huda) and the path to true felicity (Muflihun). It underscores that success is not merely material but spiritual, achieved through adherence to the Prophet's household and the Imams who preserve the Quran's esoteric meaning.
